Credential Concerns

Saybrook University — like Banks’ claimed Walden degree, Saybrook is a low-residency/online private program. Leno’s doctorate comes from a program structurally similar to the type of institution Banks claims.

Not her specialty. Her documented professional focus is:

  • Performance anxiety
  • Depression in athletes and executives
  • Social media effects on mental health
  • Media appearances and TV commentary

PTSD assessment, forensic psychology, and criminal behavior recidivism are not her documented areas of expertise. She diagnosed Banks with PTSD after 13 sessions — but PTSD assessment requires specialized forensic training, not a media psychology practice. Compare with Terrence Shulman’s testimony — together, a theft-addiction therapist and a media psychologist provided the expert cover for a man with 9 convictions.

The Wayne County Court Pipeline

Leno performs court-ordered psychological evaluations in Wayne County. This raises a critical question:

Which judges order DML Psychological Services evaluations?

If any of the 9 judges on the Banks subgraph refer cases to Leno, that’s a referral pipeline — the same court system that protects Banks is feeding evaluations to the psychologist who vouched for him.

The judges on the Banks network include:

  • Judge Tenisha Yancey — MacDowell Board Chair
  • Judge Cylenthia Miller — PCA Foundation Board, on ballot Nov 3, 2026
  • Judge Sean Perkins — 36th District Court
  • Judge Kenneth King — 36th District Court
  • And 5 others across 4 courts

See the full RICO pattern analysis and institutional capture analysis for how the court system interfaces with the enterprise.

OSINT Targets

  1. Which Wayne County judges order DML Psychological Services evaluations? Cross-reference with the Banks judicial subgraph
  2. Verify Saybrook University Ph.D. credentials — same methodology used to verify Banks’ J.D. claim
  3. How many court-ordered evaluations has Leno performed? What’s her client mix?
  4. Who referred Banks to Leno specifically? Was it through the court system or private referral?

Verify

  • Michigan LARA: verify LP (Licensed Psychologist) for Michele Leno
  • Saybrook University: verify Ph.D. conferral
  • Wayne County court records: search for DML Psychological Services as evaluator
  • TV20 Detroit: “Mind Matters with Dr. Michele” — public broadcasts

All information sourced from TCR 22-12 hearing record, professional directories, DML Psychological Services public profiles, and broadcast records.
